title: Reptilian — Cold Blood and Scale

classification.applies_to: existing supported tags of every Reptilian jutsu

emphasis.primary: Increase Damage Given — two stacking 35% rows (Reptile Chimera self, Cool-Blooded Empowerment circle)
emphasis.secondary: Decrease Damage Taken — Reptile Chimera hide (single row, +10 ceiling)
emphasis.tertiary: Lifesteal — Cool-Blooded Empowerment feeding (single ally/self row, +10 ceiling)
emphasis.rationale: Four supported rows sit on two 40 AP, cooldown-7 buffs: Reptile Chimera (A-rank, SELF) carries 35% Increase Damage Given (Ninjutsu-filtered, element-less) and 35% Decrease Damage Taken (all four stat types); Cool-Blooded Empowerment (D-rank, ALLY, radius-1 circle) carries 35% Increase Damage Given and 35% Lifesteal (Highest-filtered, element-less), each for 2 rounds. The caster is a legal ALLY target at the pin, so both IDG rows can sit on the caster at once; IDG is primary by coverage but its ceiling is held to +7 as a two-row stack. Mitigation and lifesteal are single rows and take the Taiyo Kami +10 single-row shape. Summoning: Reptile Zoo (summon, injectjutsus, visual; PVP only) and its injected Reptile King are unsupported.

nodes.name: Chimeric Blood
nodes.flavor: The blood remembers every beast it has been and lends their strength to its bearer.
nodes.coverage_note: Reptile Chimera IDG 35→37% and DDT 35→37%; Cool-Blooded Empowerment IDG 35→37% (circle: allies and caster); 2 rounds per 40 AP cast.

nodes.name: Apex Instinct
nodes.flavor: Nothing in the swamp hunts the hunter. It learns to strike first.
nodes.coverage_note: Both Increase Damage Given rows (+2 more: 39% with Chimeric Blood); Ninjutsu-filtered or element-less hits for 2 rounds; pierce excluded.

nodes.name: Jaws of the Chimera
nodes.flavor: Three sets of jaws close at once, and whatever they tear is swallowed.
nodes.coverage_note: Both IDG rows to 42% (route +7); Cool-Blooded Empowerment Lifesteal 35→37% (+2, below Serpent's Thirst). Each window 2 rounds.

nodes.name: Hardened Scales
nodes.flavor: Each shed skin leaves the next one thicker.
nodes.coverage_note: Reptile Chimera Decrease Damage Taken only (+3 more: 40% with Chimeric Blood); every stat-typed non-pierce hit; 2 rounds per cast.

nodes.name: Basilisk Carapace
nodes.flavor: Blades skate off the carapace; what little bleeds is drunk back.
nodes.coverage_note: Reptile Chimera DDT to 45% (route +10); Cool-Blooded Empowerment Lifesteal +2 (37%, circle recipients). Pierce bypasses DDT.

nodes.name: Blood of the Brood
nodes.flavor: The brood shares one cold blood, and what one drinks warms them all.
nodes.coverage_note: Cool-Blooded Empowerment Lifesteal 35→38% for same-side users in the radius-1 circle (caster included); 2 rounds; 60% leech cap with vamp.

nodes.name: Serpent's Thirst
nodes.flavor: A serpent does not stop at the first mouthful.
nodes.coverage_note: Same Lifesteal row (+3 more: 41% with Blood of the Brood); includes pierce hits the recipient lands; needs both combatants alive.

nodes.name: Feast of Scales
nodes.flavor: The brood feeds until its hide is too thick to bite through.
nodes.coverage_note: Cool-Blooded Empowerment Lifesteal to 45% (route +10, under the 60% cap); Reptile Chimera DDT +2 (37%, or 39% with Chimeric Blood).

examples.name: Jaws of the Chimera
examples.rationale: The offense build: both Increase Damage Given rows reach 42%, so the caster's own Reptile Chimera window and the circle's buff on allies (and on the caster standing in it) land harder; Hardened Scales makes Chimera's hide 40%, so the same 40 AP cast is also the mitigation window; the +2 Lifesteal secondary adds a trickle of sustain. Blood of the Brood is the alternative fourth purchase (circle lifesteal 38%, hide 37%) for a player who fights beside allies.

examples.name: Basilisk Carapace
examples.rationale: The survival build: Reptile Chimera's Decrease Damage Taken reaches 45% for its 2-round window every 7 rounds, its Increase Damage Given 37%, and Cool-Blooded Empowerment's Lifesteal 40% (+2 from the capstone, +3 from Blood of the Brood) for everyone in the circle. Apex Instinct is the alternative fourth purchase (IDG 39% on both rows, no extra lifesteal) for a solo player who wants the hide and a sharper bite.

examples.name: Feast of Scales
examples.rationale: The lifesteal build: Cool-Blooded Empowerment's Lifesteal reaches 45% for every same-side user in the circle, caster included, leaving 15 points of headroom under the 60% leech budget for the bloodline's own 10% Ninjutsu passive; the capstone's +2 Decrease Damage Taken and Chimeric Blood's +2 take Chimera's hide to 39% and its buff to 37%. Chimeric Blood is the only legal fourth purchase; the route trades the Chimera routes' depth for the strongest team sustain.

narrow_kit_exception: Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. The kit has three supported tags on four rows (Increase Damage Given x2 on Reptile Chimera and Cool-Blooded Empowerment; Decrease Damage Taken x1 on Reptile Chimera; Lifesteal x1 on Cool-Blooded Empowerment); Summoning: Reptile Zoo and its injected Reptile King carry only summon, injectjutsus and visual rows. The self-facing root (Chimeric Blood) forks into an Increase Damage Given route and a Decrease Damage Taken route; the circle-facing root (Blood of the Brood) is a single Foundation → Hidden → Advanced lifesteal chain. A fourth route would have to repeat one of the three tags: a second IDG Hidden Art under Blood of the Brood would twin Apex Instinct and open a second path past the +7 two-row ceiling, and a second DDT or Lifesteal chain would breach the +10 single-row guardrail in a full build or duplicate an existing route on the same single row, so it is declined. Three distinct complete builds (Predation, Fortress, Pack sustain) exist; Predation and Fortress each have two fourth-purchase choices, Pack sustain's fourth purchase is always Chimeric Blood. 8 legal full-budget allocations, all 8 non-dominated.
design_notes: Node split: Chimeric Blood (self-facing; both Reptile Chimera rows plus the circle's IDG row) forks into Apex Instinct → Jaws of the Chimera (Increase Damage Given 2/2/3 = +7 on two rows) and Hardened Scales → Basilisk Carapace (Decrease Damage Taken 2/3/5 = +10 on one row). Blood of the Brood (circle-facing) runs one chain, Serpent's Thirst → Feast of Scales (Lifesteal 3/3/4 = +10 on one row). 2/3/3 Foundations/Hidden/Advanced; every Advanced Art is 3 BP deep; any two cost 5 or 6 BP.

Increase Damage Given reaches two rows that can both sit on the caster (Chimera 35% Ninjutsu-filtered; Empowerment 35% Highest-filtered; the caster is a legal ALLY target), so its route is held to +7, a two-row ceiling (Taiyo Kami's two stacking IDG rows stop at +5; Loup-Garou's single row reaches +8), with the Hidden Art at +2. DDT and Lifesteal are single rows and take the Taiyo single-row +10 shape. Capstone secondaries (+2) sit below the +3 Hidden Arts on their tags.

Passives: the Ninjutsu IDG passive (20 + 0.15/level, multiplicative) and the 10% Ninjutsu Lifesteal passive stack with the enhanced rows; both buffs cast in one round (80% AP) give 70% → 84% IDG for 2 rounds (Predation build). Both IDG rows are element-less: they multiply every element-less non-pierce hit of any stat type plus elemental hits of their stat type (SOURCE_MECHANICS §3). The DDT row lists all four stat types, so it also blunts Genjutsu hits the 10% Genjutsu IDT passive worsens.

Delivery: both carriers: 40 AP, cooldown 7, 350 chakra/stamina; windows are 2 following rounds, so at most 2 of 7 rounds carry enhanced value. Reptile Chimera is SELF, range 0. Cool-Blooded Empowerment is ALLY, range 4, AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN: the clicked tile must hold a living same-side user (the caster's own tile qualifies: util.ts 2750–2752); its rows apply once at cast as user effects to every same-village user within radius 1 (actions.ts 1239–1240; friendlyFire FRIENDLY). Not a ground effect.

Fourth purchases: Predation (01,02,03) adds Hardened Scales (hide 40%) or Blood of the Brood (lifesteal 38%); Fortress (01,04,05) adds Blood of the Brood (lifesteal 40%) or Apex Instinct (IDG 39%); Pack sustain (06,07,08) only Chimeric Blood. Capstone-less hybrids (01,02,04,06; 01,02,06,07; 01,04,06,07) are legal and non-dominated. Row-weighted peak 21 on 4 rows (Taiyo Kami 31 on 9), raw 14; see risks for per-row intensity.
risks: Classification: every supported row is element-less, so no existing element isolates this kit; under the current resolver the rows are reachable only with affectedElements including None, which also reaches every non-elemental row on any jutsu the player casts. The tree assumes the proposed bloodline-keyed classification extension (label Reptilian). Normal-jutsu collision is unverified.

Increase Damage Given stacking: Reptile Chimera and Cool-Blooded Empowerment can both buff the caster in the same window (the caster is a legal ALLY target at the pin), so the Predation build adds +14 percentage points across the two rows (70% → 84%) on top of the Ninjutsu passive; BATTLE_TAG_STACKING is true at the pin. Combined final damage was not simulated.

Lifesteal budget: lifesteal and vamp share one 60%-of-damage leech budget per hit. The route reaches 45% on Cool-Blooded Empowerment; a caster inside the circle adds the 10% Ninjutsu passive (55%), so any vamp or lifesteal from the main tree or items saturates the capstone. The buffed user heals from their own hits (pierce included); both must be alive; healprevent on the recipient blocks it.

Highest resolution: Cool-Blooded Empowerment's rows carry statTypes [Highest], which realizeTag resolves from the casting user's highestOffence (G16), so on an ally the efficiency ratio tests the caster's highest stat, not the ally's. Element-less rows still match every element-less hit of any stat type; only elemental hits of another stat type are excluded. Undefined highestOffence unverified.

Team dependence and village check: the circle buffs land on same-village users (getTargetUser compares villageId), so an ally from another village is not reached even though the tile filter accepts any same-side user; in a 1v1 the circle reaches only the caster. Blood of the Brood's chain therefore carries less value solo (single recipient) than in team fights.

Summoning: Reptile Zoo (PVP only) and its injected Reptile King (SPECIAL, empty bloodlineId, summon row only) have no supported rows; no node changes them, and the injected child is not counted under open decision D4 option (a). The 10% Genjutsu Increase Damage Taken passive remains a standing weakness outside the Chimera window.

Per-row intensity: the strongest full build is row-weighted 21 on 4 rows (5.25 per row against Taiyo Kami's 3.44), above the balance matrix's 125% outlier line, because every purchase lands on one of four rows; raw additions (14) are the lowest among drafted trees. Flagged for the cross-roster review rather than tuned away here.

No adverse supported rows, hidden rows, item gates or ally-hazard rows exist in this kit; the unsupported visual rows (adverse) are untouched by every node. Uptime, whether a same-round buff applies to that round's hits, and AP sequencing were not verified against combat timing.

limits: Proposed potency classification behavior; not implemented or verified in the live engine.
All existing supported tags of Reptilian jutsu inherit Reptilian potency eligibility; original combat elements and target scopes stay intact.
Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.
Damage values are raw power, not final-damage percentages; percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.

Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.
Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.
No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.
Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit.
